reviews.text:
I'm very grateful to every member of the team. I had three elderly cats, one of whom recently passed away. I joined Vets on the Common over the last six months and have had to visit frequently between the three of them. I can honestly say this is the most accommodating, understanding, and competent vet practice I have ever been to. They made my cat's final weeks as comfortable as possible, and I was able to share some amazing last moments with her thanks to the team's compassion and accommodation of her specific needs.
​
After using two other local practices in Battersea and Clapham and not being satisfied, this one hands down has my complete trust and beats them by miles.
​
Thank you again to everyone on the team.

So grateful to everyone who looked after Tinker for his dental and gave him so much love <3 such kind staff and such a stunning practice! Especially thankyou to Paige for her reassurance and updates throughout the day and also making sure he was well loved 🥹

First time visit
Absolutely amazing
Clean tidy well presented
Staff exceptional went over and above to help and look after my cat that had a toilet accident inside her carry box which the wonderful receptionist cleaned and assured it was not a problem
I didn’t get her name but thank you so very much
I will certainly be back in the future
Kind regards Paul
And Tilly the cat 👍
Exceptional care. Could not recommend highly enough
Absolutely loved our first visit. Wasn't rushed and we got to ask Dr Vici all our questions about our adolescent pup.
Excellent staff, very politevery experience Very, very helpful and anytime, thank you very much
Helpful and caring vet!
My cat had an operation, she was super well looked after and so was I as I had loads of questions. Highly recommend this practice!
Thank you for the 5*'s Lydia :-)
Incredibly patient, attentive, helpful. Everything you would want from a Vet. Just fantastic
Very good, attentive doctors.

Finding a good exotic vet is hard, there aren't many choices and those that exist are far away. I was initially a little worried as vets on the common aren't an exotics specialist, but they have blown all expectations out of the water.

Dr Michael has been phenomenal looking after my girl! I rescued her and she wasn't in the best condition, and had a severe case of follicular stasis which required surgery. They took great care in performing the surgery and in the aftercare afterwards.

It's clear that everyone adored Beverly and made her feel like a VIP, and the service was stellar start to finish.

We had to make several emergency visits the days after her surgery as she was a bit touch and go for a while, but with their guidance she has pulled through!

Thank you to the team and I hope I won't see you for a while!

Hattie came for her annual check.  Everything is calm, friendly and efficient.  The vet was kind and patient and genuinely came across as someone who cared for his patients. Hattie particularly liked the liver pate treat used to distract her when it came to the vaccination.  Easy.   I use an independent vet as I don't like the chains who push sales and want a more honest service.

This is hands down the best vets you can get. Only problem with them is they’re irreplaceable. I moved to the other side of London and still travel here with my cat for check ups despite having to take a taxi across town. Having tried all the nearby vets, none comes close to the level of care these guys provide. My cat is exceptionally nervous but she is extremely relaxed here.
Michael is an incredible vet - they all are to be honest. Couldn’t recommend more.

After experiencing veterinary negligence at Voo Vets, I made the move to Vets on the Common in October 2024. From the very start, Dr Michael was warm, welcoming and supportive of me and my cat. I see Michael at every appointment and he is always prepared for Ivy’s visits and shows genuine care for her recovery. The nurses are all friendly and responsive too. The new cat only area is great and helps to keep Ivy calm during our visits. I’m very happy with our experience so far!

I have been bringing my two cats into Vets on the Common for almost a year now and cannot recommend them enough to anyone in the area. All the doctors and nurses are so kind, empathetic, helpful and ensure that every trip to the vet is calm for both pet and owner. The prices are so transparent and fair, especially compared to the bigger chains. We love the team there and thank them for everything they have done.
We are so grateful to the team at vets on the common. The team here are wonderful with cats, patient with nervous owners, and  honest about treatment. No upselling or unnecessary procedures.

Brilliant vet.
Super friendly staff, super competent and - bonus point - separate sections for cats and dogs so no stress for the kitties...

I really like this vet, came one time (want to come more often but not much parking) and the vets dr and nurses seem extremely knowledgable in animals. My cat has a limp (torn ligament on his knee) and just by touching his legs, they instantly knew. I went to petsathome beforehand and they just said he’s just overweight, not in pain and made him run around! My guts knew my little boy was in pain and they fixed him very fast. But please we need more parking somehow

I had the most amazing and comforting experience with Vets on the Common. My dog had been passed down the family and Dr Liam filled me with so much knowledge and confidence as a somewhat new dog owner. His temper with Luna was so calming. The girls on the front desk are also rays of sunshine 🌞 Thank you to all! …

Thank you for devoting your strong heart and smart mind to this work. The energy you share is a wonderful gift to the world. I am sorry we met under these circumstances but I'm glad that you have a gentle soul and a kind heart.
Thank you Dr. Elly
With love from Johnny and Sherine

I couldn’t be happier with the care our girl received.
She underwent three procedures in a single operation, and everything was handled with exceptional professionalism and expertise. The entire team was kind, attentive, and genuinely caring.
What impressed me the most was the aftercare. They called us during the first two days to check on her progress and make sure she was recovering well, and the personal follow-up examination with the surgeon 48 hours after the operation gave us so much reassurance and confidence that she was in the best hands.
I’m truly grateful that we chose this clinic. The level of care, communication, and compassion exceeded all our expectations. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.
Easy to book; the vet was very experienced and walked us through everything we need to get done for our kitten

Front desk team and vets are genuinely so kind and reliable. Will always update and clarify when needed. Otis had a dental surgery and we received a personalised dental discharge letter with post care management, which was a very nice touch, it goes to show they do go far and beyond. Honestly can’t find any fault.
Highly recommend this vets , they help wildlife and its great as not many do , they generally care and its awesome to have vets and staff that do and go out there way to help 😀 …

Really lovely vets who give very personal care. Liam looked after our cat brilliantly, going out of his way to accommodate last minute requests for follow up appointments etc. All the nurses couldn’t have been kinder. I would highly recommend taking your pets to this wonderful independent vet practice.

I have found the whole experience of dealing with the vets extremely distressing. They are not professional, they have given us the wrong information and they didn’t seem to care. Our cat is now in heaven.

Great clinic and lovely staff.

The clinic is spotless, efficient and always available on the phone when in need.

I would definitely recommend it.

Today I went with my little cav to her first appointment, and honestly they were incredibly kind and efficient. Even though some things can be a bit challenging for me since I’m not bilingual, the visit felt very easy and clear. I will definitely come back again whenever I need to 🤍 …

Excellent practice - I highly recommend vets on the common. Their prices are reasonable and their services excellent

Michael Lazaris - the Co-owner did a thorough investigation of my cockapoo on my first visit and talked me through all the processes involved in getting my dog properly attended to.

I feel that Bobby is in very safe hands 🙌
Recommend👍🏻 …
Thank you Mercedes :-)

We’ve been bringing our cat Howard here over the past year for a few different reasons, and I can’t recommend this practice enough.

Vici and Michael have both been absolutely brilliant every single time we’ve visited. They’re friendly, calm and caring, and we  never feel rushed, and they always take the time to explain things clearly and answer any questions.

Most importantly, we completely trust them. You can tell they really know what they’re doing, but also that they really care about the animals they’re treating.

Howard is very lucky to be in such good hands!
Very good service lovely staff all pleasant and polite explain everything in detail which is perfect even rang next day to check Kaspa was alright
Very nice people well speaking and caring my molly loved it i will do insurance with you aswell
Thank you Lee :-)
Thank you May :-)

We’ve had all positive experiences here with our Ruby! She actually loves coming to the vets and loves all of the staff there!
And the liver treats and fish skins…

It’s always a relaxed atmosphere and everyone is very friendly, which helps us and Ruby.
They are always very detailed and thorough in any appointments and follow up quickly by email. Even out of hours which is helpful sometimes!

Automated receipts that they send after each appointment allows for easy insurance claims.

And they are responsive by telephone quickly.
Can also normally get an appointment quite promptly which is great.

We’ve used their in patient daycare after some xrays and anaesthetic too- and the whole experience was fantastic. Very well communicated, showed me round the facilities, followed up the next day to check on Ruby.

Highly recommend!

Needed to find an alternative vet. Called up, spoke with a helpful receptionist who quickly consulted a vet and advised the quote. Booked in for a 2nd consultation appointment on the same day, Vici was very patient, understanding and gave her recommendations to treat Kitty’s diarrhoea which came out after her teeth were extracted. Still unknown what is the cause but the treatment and experience I received at Vets on the Common is way better than my previous vet in Streatham. This vet has a very warm and welcoming atmosphere which helps a lot when owners and animals are often in a stressful situation already. The knowledgeable vet has also offered reassurance with their explanation and guide you through the process.
very friendly and thorough with our puppy gave us a lot of information about our puppies breed can not fault them fantastic
Great service, lovely staff, would recommend
Exceptional care and genuine compassion towards animals . Great smily  nurses , helpful receptionist. Our cat is in good hands.
Since getting my cat they have been my go to, very efficient, professional and great animal care. Totally recommend!

My dog Bella has been under Dr Michael’s care for many years. Bella has a real medical history of allergies and subsequent side effects. From all the vets I have taken her to, Dr Michael is by far the most attentive, caring and knowledgeable.

I cannot recommend this vet enough. From the from reception team, the nurses to the vets, they are amazing. I have many local vets near me, but I am always happy to travel over an hour just to see the amazing team at Vets on the common. Thank you for team!

Very nice experience at Vets in the Common get Export Health Certificate fir my dog. Vets are very experienced in the process and the receptionist is very helpful. My dog loves the treats there!  It’s bit difficult to find going there the first time, you need to walk through a small alley on the main road to access the vets.
Thank you David :-)
Thank you Dave :-)
Very kind and professional service! Also very efficient, highly recommended

Our experience with Michael has been by far the best we've had in many years and several veterinary practices. He's not only kind and caring with our dog, which makes us feel like he really cares about him, but he is very fair and conscious of the costs associated with that care. Whereas previous vets were relentless with the upselling, recommending additional tests and costly treatments, Michael discusses all options with us, really trying to help us find the most cost effective way to care for our pet.

I called vets on the common one evening in a state of panic and despair - our beloved cat was extremely unwell and our former vet (PE owned) kept dismissing our concerns. Even though they were just closing down for the day vets on the common discussed her symptoms and put me on to their out of hours partner to make sure someone would see our Luna that night. They also booked me to come in first thing the next day. Luna ended up needing surgery, medication and plenty of TLC all of which they gave her. They were also incredibly considerate about ringing me up regularly while she was at the clinic and giving me updates and information. And they didn’t just leave us to fend for ourselves between appointments; they called to check up on us every few days to see how she was doing. They also took care to process all the insurance paperwork and helped me manage the submission of claims. Needless to say I have since moved both our cats to this wonderful, independent veterinary service and have never looked back since.
